raw_text: Identify frequently occurring root words (e.g., look) and inflectional endings used to form and comprehend new words (e.g., looks, looked, looking). (I)
competency_statement: Identify common root words and inflectional endings to understand and form new words.
observable_behaviors: Recognize root words in spoken and written words.
Identify inflectional endings such as -s, -ed, and -ing in words.
Explain how adding inflectional endings changes the meaning of root words.
skill_clauses: Identify inflectional endings used to form new words.
Use root words and inflectional endings to comprehend new words.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Identify root words and inflectional endings in spoken and written words.
student_actions.matching_sorting_sequencing: Sort words by root word and inflectional ending.
student_actions.procedural_application: Use knowledge of root words and inflectional endings to comprehend new words.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain how inflectional endings change the meaning of root words.
